Bright Corner Bedroom in Quiet 3BR Low-Rise — 346 Westmount Rd N, Waterloo, ON

Subletting my spacious corner room for the Winter 2027 term (Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027). About an 8-minute walk to PAC and MC, right on the GRT 13/29 routes too. Rent is $950/month and covers heat, water, hydro, unlimited Wi-Fi, and 1 surface parking spot if you bring a car. Pet friendly building, great for grad or upper-year co-op students. The owner lives out in Guelph (not in the unit) and has already signed our sublet consent form. Happy to host an in-person tour any day this week—reach me at westmount346@example.com or 519-555-0182.
label_rationale: Legitimate Westmount Rd N sublet at realistic rent ($950/mo) within walking distance of UW, off-site owner, written landlord sublet consent (RTA s. 97), pet-friendly, and in-person tours offered. No RTA violations or CAFC scam red flags. Under SPEC D6, ADMIT.
